market.question: Will Natural Gas (NG) hit (LOW) $2.60 in May?

assessment.reasoning: NG futures at ~$2.72-$2.82 on May 5-7, recently hit a 1.5-year low; growing US stockpiles (+7.1% vs 5-yr avg) and above-normal spring temps weigh on prices. To hit $2.60 LOW only needs another ~4-7% drop, with 24 days remaining in May. Bearish fundamentals and existing low momentum support yes.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sudden weather shift, hurricane setup, or LNG export news could spike prices and prevent $2.60 print.
